title: Switchyard Configuration
description: Configuration for the Switchyard extension. Resolves virtual models to target models with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard routing algorithms.

virtual_models.description: Virtual models resolved by the filter. The first entry whose name and match_headers match the request wins.

name.description: The model name clients send in the request body, for example "coding-auto".

targets.description: Switchyard target names, as used in the algorithm configuration, mapped to the model names they route to.

algorithm.description: The Switchyard algorithm, in Switchyard's route configuration format. Algorithms that call a judge, a verifier or an executor model need model_calls, and algorithms with a decision judge need decision_calls.

default_model.description: Model used when routing fails and failure_mode is use_default. Must be one of the target models.

failure_mode.description: What to do when routing fails. Defaults to use_default when default_model is set, and to passthrough otherwise.

match_headers.description: Request headers that must have the given values for this virtual model to apply.

session.description: How the session identity used by stateful algorithms is read from the request headers.

id_header.description: Header carrying the session ID. Defaults to x-switchyard-session-id.

fallback_id_headers.description: Headers checked, in order, when id_header is not set. Defaults to ["agent-session-id"].

scope_headers.description: Headers whose values prefix the session ID, for example a tenant header, so that sessions are never shared across scopes.

agent_id_header.description: Header carrying the agent ID. Sub-agent requests need it to keep their own session state. Defaults to x-switchyard-agent-id.

subagent_header.description: Header flagging sub-agent requests with "true" or "1". Sub-agent requests are routed by the subagents block of the algorithm, when set. Defaults to x-switchyard-is-subagent.

endpoints.description: Request path suffixes handled by the filter, mapped to the API format of their bodies. Defaults to the OpenAI chat completions, OpenAI responses and Anthropic messages endpoints.

model_header.description: Optional request header set to the selected model, for routing on plain Envoy. Not needed with Agent Router.

clear_route_cache.description: Whether to clear the route cache after a model is selected. Not needed with Agent Router, which clears it itself. Defaults to false.

decision_headers.description: Whether to add the x-switchyard-virtual-model, x-switchyard-selected-model and x-switchyard-reason request headers. Defaults to true.

rewrite_body.description: Whether to rewrite the model field of the request body to the selected model. Set to false to keep the virtual model in the body and carry the decision only in the decision headers, model_header, dynamic metadata and filter state, so that a later filter can apply its own policy before it picks the backend. Defaults to true.

model_calls.description: How the filter calls models for the algorithms that need it: judges, verifiers, advisors and the efficient attempts of vgr. Calls are HTTP callouts to an Envoy cluster, usually one that loops back to the gateway so that it applies its credentials, rate limits, costs and telemetry to them.

cluster.description: The Envoy cluster the calls are sent to.

authority.description: The host of the calls. Defaults to the client request's.

path.description: The path of the calls. Defaults to the client request's path, or to the standard path of format when it differs from the client's.

format.description: The API format of the calls. Defaults to the client request's.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout of each call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.

forward_headers.description: Client request headers copied to every call, such as credentials, tenant and session headers, so that the gateway authenticates and charges the call like the client request.

trace_context.description: Trace context headers added to every call, so that it joins the client request's trace: w3c (traceparent) or b3. Defaults to w3c.

decision_calls.description: How the filter calls the decision API of decision judges, such as a System One endpoint or OpenAI's Decisions API.

cluster.description: The Envoy cluster the calls are sent to.

authority.description: The host of the calls. Defaults to the client request's.

path.description: The path of the decision API, such as /v1/systemone or /v1/decisions.

format.description: The API format of the decision API.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout of each call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.

forward_headers.description: Client request headers copied to every call, such as credentials, tenant and session headers, so that the gateway authenticates and charges the call like the client request.

trace_context.description: Trace context headers added to every call, so that it joins the client request's trace: w3c (traceparent) or b3. Defaults to w3c.

eligible_models_header.description: Request header with the comma-separated models a request may be routed to, for example the models of a tenant's plan. The algorithm only routes to target models in the list. The header must be set by a trusted filter, such as ext_authz, and never by the client.

routing_headers.description: Whether to add x-switchyard-routing-calls, x-switchyard-routing-input-tokens, x-switchyard-routing-output-tokens and x-switchyard-routing-total-tokens response headers with the cost of the routing calls. Defaults to false.
